summary.intent: Review pending todos and select one to work on, specifically investigating why Someguy v0.11.1 IPNS endpoints hang indefinitely on staging.
summary.outcome: Selected the Someguy IPNS routing failure todo, created a feature branch, moved the todo to done, and committed the change — ready to begin local reproduction and debugging.

repo: Someguy v0.11.1 was deployed as self-hosted IPNS routing sidecar in Phase 19 (completed 2026-03-07) but was reverted in PR #322 due to IPNS endpoint failures
The /routing/v1/ipns/ endpoints (PUT and GET) hang indefinitely while /routing/v1/providers/ works fine — suggesting the issue is IPNS-specific in someguy
Staging uses delegated-ipfs.dev as fallback after the someguy revert
IPNS publish failures cost ~30s per attempt (3 retries x 10s timeout), generating ~2,000 abort errors in 10 minutes of load testing
Local reproduction environment uses Docker host at 192.168.133.114 with Kubo v0.40.0

code.finding: Delegated routing client handles IPNS publish with 3 retries at 10s timeout each — the site of the ~30s waste per failed publish
Relevant for reproducing the someguy sidecar setup locally
Staging compose config that had someguy configured before the revert

workflow: GSD check-todos workflow correlates todos against roadmap phases automatically, surfacing that this issue is a regression from a previously 'completed' phase

friction: Someguy IPNS endpoints hang indefinitely with no error response, making debugging harder than a clear failure mode
The revert to delegated-ipfs.dev means the self-hosted routing goal is blocked until this is resolved
open_items: Reproduce the IPNS hang locally with Docker + Kubo v0.40.0 and test endpoints directly
Check for known someguy bugs related to IPNS endpoint behavior
Validate fix with SDK E2E tests and load tests before re-deploying to staging
Re-enable someguy as self-hosted IPNS router once the root cause is identified and fixed (previously reverted in PR #322)
